title: Modern Suite 6BR, 3,400 sq ft Walkable to Broadway
description:
Walk to Broadway from our 3,400 sq ft 2nd floor Modern suite at The Maddox Hotel. Suite has a modern vibe and is the perfect place for group trips, bachelorette / bachelor parties, corporate retreats, executive getaways, business meetings or special occasions like Birthdays! All with the comforts of home!  Every member of your group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located suite. TPAC, Bridgestone Arena, Titans Stadium, The Gulch, and 2nd & Broadway are all within walking

The space
Our beautifully furnished 3,459 sq feet suite comes with 6 bedrooms and 3 1/2 baths. Also has its own pool table, cards and board games to keep the party going. All complete with a list of amenities that recognize you for the VIP that you are.

Guest access
Main entrance at 200 6th Ave N, Nashville, TN 37219

Other things to note
There is a downtown grocery store within walking distance called Urban Market or a Whole Foods and Publix, both a mile away.
